method: Nine complete source images inspected individually against saved briefs; source hashes captured.
scope: Independent model critique of finished still key art. No human approval or game-implementation claim.

evidence: Crescent instrument has visible hand/support structure and directs a clear reflected hazard line along the causeway.
Blindfold, emaciated adult body and rust cloth distinguish a ritual scholar from the military bosses.
Eclipse, salt causeway and buried observation rings form coherent regional identity.
nonblocking_limits: Reflection is authored fantasy behaviour, not physically validated eclipse optics.

evidence: Three joined sail-shell volumes and a low eyeless muscular foot give a striking nonhumanoid silhouette.
Falling sand and exposed lens well tie migration directly to dungeon transformation.
Fleeing expedition figures provide a more dynamic scale narrative than a stationary comparison figure.
Six visible stone weights and a tightly woven root knot produce an original siege-working form.
The lifted weight and breaking causeway clearly link action and consequence.
Tiny ward team, still black water and restrained red fissure make threat legible without a demon face.
nonblocking_limits: The upper suspension extends outside the frame; this does not establish a complete construction diagram.

evidence: Half-drawn actual blade and longer reflected blade convey the single uncanny cue.
Mature androgynous face and severe plain warcloth support controlled duelist menace.
Offset subject and large reflection area create useful composition variety within the boss collection.
nonblocking_limits: Shadow-vein laterality cannot be treated as a verified model-sheet detail from this view.

evidence: Sweeping stair below and ceiling return above establish a bounded local spatial anomaly.
Mountain entrance, fallen gear and wet stone provide arrival context and physical material cues.
publication_blockers: Remove the small pale outlined interlocking rectangular mark at the lower-right corner: it reads as an accidental watermark/signature, not convincing diegetic architecture.
nonblocking_limits: Environment composition repeats the two-explorer lower-left arrival staging used in adjacent plates.

evidence: Glacial wall layering, timber ribs and visible thaw channel make the monastery region clear.
Broken crossing, lateral route and machinery provide exploration choices.
publication_blockers: Remove the prominent left wall inscription reading approximately QUI / ENDURE / PRESERVE / FURTHER; its arbitrary pseudo-sentence weakens finished-world credibility. Retain plain weathered stone or a deliberately authored nontext relief.
nonblocking_limits: Directional signs are readable and coherent, but should not be treated as independently established canon labels.

evidence: Mineral roots overtaking botanical terraces convey the original research purpose and later ecological change.
Causeway branches, sinkholes and distant crater walls provide useful depth and choices.
Warm emerald daylight sustains mature wonder.
nonblocking_limits: Two figures at lower-left with middle crossing repeat the shared environment arrival formula.

evidence: Open circular court and severe quartz fins establish the trial arena while preserving room to move.
Distant mountain landmark and local damaged access create two destination scales.
Ivory, graphite and controlled warm seams match the Glass Sovereign setting.
nonblocking_limits: Detail-rich stairs and statues are less severe than the original minimal-court brief, but the central arena retains visual rest.

evidence: Suspended keel, capstans, load cranes and waves express the arsenal purpose and current storm pressure.
Clear foreground catwalk and opposing route choices make the setting explorable.
publication_blockers: Remove the prominent right wall inscription BUILDS / FEED. / REALMS; it reads as accidentally generated copy. Preserve weathered stone and statue.
nonblocking_limits: Directional signs are coherent; the image remains illustrative geography rather than an exact navigable level.

collection_notes: Bosses in this batch widen silhouette and composition: crescent scholar, migrating shell, suspended siege knot, reflected duelist.

Five environments use a repeated arrival grammar: two lower-left explorers, a middle crossing and a distant destination. It is coherent but not radical composition variety. Curate gallery sequencing to vary light, location and boss/environment scale.
Three focused removal edits are needed; do not redraw otherwise successful environments unnecessarily.
